name: Human Worm that Walks Sorcerer 10 (CR 11)
body:
HUMAN WORM THAT WALKS SORCERER 10
CR 11

XP 12,800
Human worm that walks sorcerer 10
CE Medium vermin (aquatic, augmented human)
Init +2; Senses aquatic blindsense 30 ft., blindsight, darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 82 (10d6+40); fast healing 11
Fort +6, Ref +5, Will +10
Defensive Abilities worm that walks traits; DR 15/—; Immune flanking, critical hits, disease, paralysis, poison, sleep; Resist cold 5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee slam +5 (1d6 plus grab)
Special Attacks dehydrating touch (9/day), discorporate, grab, squirming embrace (2d6+0) (dc 18)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; melee touch +5, ranged touch +7):

9/day—dehydrating touch (1d6+5 non-lethal damage)

Spells Known (CL 10th; melee touch +5, ranged touch +7):

5th (4/day)—hold monster (DC 21)
4th (6/day)—confusion (DC 20), geyser (DC 20)B*, stoneskin
3rd (7/day)—aqueous orb (DC 19)B*, arcane sight, dispel magic, slow (DC 19)
2nd (8/day)—bear’s endurance, glitterdust, resist energy, scorching ray, slipstream (DC 18)B*
1st (8/day)—burning hands (DC 17), expeditious retreat, grease (DC 17), hydraulic pushB*, mage armor, shocking grasp
0 (at will)—acid splash, bleed (DC 16), arcane mark, dancing lights, detect magic, flare (DC 16), mage hand, ray of frost, read magic

Bloodline Aquatic*

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 14, Con 17, Int 16, Wis 13, Cha 23
Base Atk +5; CMB +5 (+13 grappling); CMD 23
Feats Diehard, Eschew Materials, Iron Will, Magical Aptitude, Silent Spell, Skill Focus (Knowledge [arcana]), Skill Focus (spellcraft), Skill Focus (swim), Toughness +10
Skills Appraise +9, Bluff +10, Craft (alchemy) +13, Diplomacy +8, Fly +9, Intimidate +17, Knowledge (arcana) +22, Knowledge (geography) +8, Knowledge (local) +8, Knowledge (nature) +9, Knowledge (planes) +7, Linguistics +4, Perception +9, Sense Motive +9, Spellcraft +26, Stealth +10, Swim +13, Use Magic Device +13
Languages Abyssal, Aquan, Common, Sylvan; aquatic telepathy
SQ aquatic adaption, amphibious, bloodline arcana (+1 level to all water spells)
Gear scroll of enervation and scroll of hallow in a canvas scrollcase sealed with whale blubber, potion of water breathing, staff of waves (2 charges; see sidebar); Other Gear ring of swimming, 522 gp
